BFA.note: Document states no authentication, e-signature or PKI service.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.
The CNIB is named only as an accepted document; nothing on issuance, biometrics or certification.
SIM sale requires presenting the CNIB as a document; no check against the ID database is stated.

facts.fact: ANOTEL, applying decree 2023-1721 of 15 December 2023, states that the refugee identity card and refugee attestation issued by CONAREF are the only documents accepted for refugees to buy a SIM card.
